deviations: RESUMED RUN, NOT A FRESH ONE (user-directed, interactive 2026-08-20). The 2026-08-19 scheduled run died immediately after emitting the thesis prompt. This session picked the cycle up at that seam and ran everything from 3(e) onward. Steps 3(a) through 3(d4) were NOT re-run and their artifacts are the dead run's own, read back from disk. No re-gather, by explicit user direction.

Step 3(e)/(e2)/(e3) TOOL-LESS-BRAIN DEVIATION (unchanged from the 2026-08-04 onward cycles, still awaiting the user ruling): this harness exposes no tool-less subagent type, so each brain was dispatched on model opus with an explicit binding instruction to use ONLY Read on its own prompt files and no other tool.

Step 3(e)/(e2)/(e3) BRAIN-WRITES-ITS-OWN-ANSWER (NEW THIS CYCLE, AFK-default, flagged to the user in-session): prior cycles had the brain return its answer as text for the coordinator to transcribe. The thesis answer here is 65 judgments; hand-transcribing it would have risked a silent typo in a stored artifact. So each brain was granted Read on its own prompt files PLUS exactly one Write to its own answer path, and nothing else. The property the tool-less rule exists to protect is intact - no brain could fetch anything outside its prompt - but this IS a change from the recorded practice and is called out rather than left silent. It also replaces the 2026-08-11 scripted-string-substitution workaround: gate retries were fixed by re-dispatching the brain to rewrite its own file.

Step 3(e2) PROMPT SPLIT (unchanged): the implication prompt was split verbatim into system.txt / user.txt / schema.json, and the narrator prompt into system.txt / schema.json / user-part1..4.txt, under work/daily-2026-08-19/. Both splits were verified by exact round-trip reassembly against the emitted prompt before dispatch; content is byte-identical, only re-laid-out across files.

Step 7b SERIES-READER TOOL-WALL DEVIATION (unchanged): the F88 injection wall requires readers/gatherers to hold Read/Write/WebSearch/WebFetch and never Bash. No available subagent type restricts tools to exactly that set, so the three series readers and the three chart researchers were dispatched as general-purpose agents with an explicit binding no-shell instruction. The wall was instructed, not structurally enforced - flagged for the user alongside the standing tool-less-brain ruling.

Step 3(e4) CITATION AUDIT left with one open implication flag rather than escalating to a narrator fallback - see citationAudit.note. The procedure's second-failure fallback exists for narrator flags; discarding a clean story over an implication-side flag would be the wrong reading of it.

Step 3(f) SESSION-OUTPUT DEVIATION (F67): the rendered report is 1099 lines, too large to paste verbatim into the session final message. The final message carries the report's executive sections and references the full rendered report by path instead. Recorded as an AFK-default.
